summary: First test iteration for CareSync Pro (Expo FR offline-first app). Backend: 4/4 pytest tests passed (health + OCR receipt JSON + OCR receipt data-URI + OCR odometer) using real base64 JPEG images generated with PIL. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Home shows seeded daily summary (next RDV 10:30 with recommended departure 10:05, 3 expenses, last trip 45 km) and 3 module cards navigate correctly. Theme toggle works end-to-end: surface background rgb(255,255,255) -> rgb(17,24,39) and persists after reload (AsyncStorage). Comptabilite: 3 seeded expenses, total 73.70 EUR, add expense via FAB works (total went to 86.20 EUR), edit opens form, delete works, session-create-chip and export-session-btn present. Agenda: month-grid renders Oct 2026 with event bars, month-prev navigates to Sept 2026, add-event-fab opens form, departure-box updates dynamically when field-travel/field-buffer change (09:30 -> 08:45), status-effectue reveals field-post-comment. Vehicule: trip-total-km=90 km, add-trip-fab opens form, km start prefilled to 84290 from last trip's km end, trip-km-calc updates live (0 km -> 25 km), save adds trip (total 90 -> 115 km), delete works. No React Native red screens, no deprecated Expo packages, no critical blocking issues.

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow'. 4 usages in /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src. Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+/web compliance.

action_items: Optional: Replace shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset with boxShadow across frontend to silence RN Web deprecation warning.

Note: review_request mentioned testIDs 'total-km', 'field-km-start', 'field-km-end', 'session-chip', 'event-form-close' - actual code uses 'trip-total-km', 'trip-km-start', 'trip-km-end', 'session-chip-{id}'/'trip-session-chip-{id}', 'event-form-close' (last matches). The internal naming is consistent and the UI works; just a doc/testID-naming nit for future test specs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py OCR amount parsing (line 129): the chained isinstance+isdigit guard is overly complex and will reject many valid floats (e.g. negative or scientific). A simpler try/except float() cast would be more robust, though current tests pass.
No MongoDB models actually used despite motor client being initialized - DB connection is unused. Could remove to simplify, or keep for future offline-sync endpoints.
Frontend uses AsyncStorage for all data (expected per MVP spec). No pagination on list screens - fine for seed-data MVP but will need pagination/virtualization once trip/expense counts grow.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py (replaced hardcoded BASE_URL with env-driven value falling back to preview URL)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Verified existing demo seed on first launch (3 expenses, 3 events, 2 trips, 1 session). Test-created items (TEST Boulangerie expense, TEST Destination trip) were deleted at the end of the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a FR offline-first Expo app with 3 tabs (Comptabilite, Agenda, Vehicule) + Home. All state in AsyncStorage, seeded on first launch. Backend has only 3 endpoints (/api/, /api/ocr/receipt, /api/ocr/odometer) using emergentintegrations LlmChat with gpt-5.6-terra vision. Camera/notifications only work on native, not web - skip them. Correct testIDs for Vehicule: trip-total-km, trip-km-start, trip-km-end, trip-km-calc, trip-save, trip-delete, trip-row-{id}, trip-session-chip-{id}. For Agenda: month-grid, month-prev, month-next, day-YYYY-MM-DD, add-event-fab, event-form-close, event-row-{id}, departure-box, field-travel, field-buffer, status-effectue, field-post-comment. Theme toggle testID: theme-toggle-btn (color scheme persisted in AsyncStorage under key for theme). Use viewport 390x844.
